spec_match.rationale: The restriction table (cube arrays, GLES 3.1 rationale, etc.) tracks the compatibility-mode proposal's shape, but rows are uncited and static — and the mode is directly requestable at runtime (requestAdapter({ featureLevel: 'compatibility' })), which the page never attempts.

interactive.rationale: Reference table + note + code, no controls. The obvious live element — request a compat adapter and enumerate its real limits/features beside the core adapter's — is absent.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Promises 'what is restricted…and how to write portable shaders' as a hands-on concept; delivers a static table.

edge_cases.rationale: No handling for navigator.gpu absent, adapter null (this sandbox's real state), or compat-vs-core divergence on the visitor's device.

references.rationale: Feature index links chromestatus; the table's per-row reasons cite no spec/proposal anchors.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite exists; page anchors nothing.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP run: 25px horizontal page overflow measured at 360×740 DPR3 (limits table lacks a scroll wrapper); desktop clean; zero console errors.

design_system.rationale: Emerald/rose as text colours on light cells — passes AA (unlike sibling pages that invert them).

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: 25px horizontal page overflow at 360×740 DPR3 (measured); desktop 1280×2000 clean.

openQuestions.title: Fix the 25px mobile overflow
openQuestions.detail: Wrap the limits table in an overflow-x:auto container (measured 25px page overflow at 360px).

openQuestions.title: Request a real compatibility adapter and diff its limits live
openQuestions.detail: Call navigator.gpu.requestAdapter({ featureLevel: 'compatibility' }) and requestAdapter() and render the actual limits/features diff for the visitor's device, with honest null-adapter handling (this sandbox returns null — a state the page must show, not hide).

guidanceConsulted.query: reference table live api diff mobile scroll wrapper
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Own horizontal scroll inside wrappers; derive claims from runtime where possible.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Neither applied — both filed as questions.

summary: Reviewed headlessly (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): a static restrictions table with a measured 25px mobile overflow and no attempt at the live compat-adapter request that would make it a real demo. Layout fix (moderate) and live-diff question (major) filed.
